title: ezcap Lua driver manifest
description: Declarative manifest describing a sandboxed Lua driver script. Validated before any script is loaded.

script.description: Path of the script, relative to the manifest or allowlisted directory.

script_sha256.description: Optional integrity pin over the script source text.

capabilities.description: Capabilities negotiated at load time. Enforced at binding-registration time; anything not declared here is absent from the script's lezcap table.

event_types.description: Normalized event categories the driver subscribes to. Subscriptions are reductions over the existing pipeline, never expansions.

max_endpoints.description: Self-imposed ceiling on declared endpoints; may only lower the engine default.
